confirmedFlows.evidence: Order intake: Shopify orders → NetSuite (as cash sales or sales orders, with routing logic).

confirmedFlows.name: Shopify Order → NetSuite Sales Order

confirmedFlows.evidence: Order intake: Shopify orders → NetSuite (as cash sales or sales orders, with routing logic).

p0Blockers.title: Celigo Flow Inventory Spreadsheet
p0Blockers.clientAction: Please send the flow inventory spreadsheet referenced as 'ATTACHMENT — TO BE PROVIDED' in your intake document. It contains the ~23 flow names, source/target systems, run frequency, volume, criticality, and owners.
p0Blockers.body: DataSkate cannot confirm final flow count or price accurately without this spreadsheet. The 10 flow categories scoped here likely contain multiple sub-flows within Celigo. Actual flow count may range from 10 to 23+ depending on how each category is structured. This is the single most critical missing artifact. Sikich manages Celigo day-to-day and likely maintains the inventory — ask them.
bundledWith: NetSuite TBA Credentials (request from Sikich in same call)

p0Blockers.title: NetSuite TBA Credentials (via Sikich)
p0Blockers.clientAction: Ask your Sikich account manager to create a dedicated MuleSoft integration role in NetSuite and generate TBA credentials: Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, Token ID, Token Secret. Also request: item master export (product code → NetSuite internal ID mapping), custom field names from your Celigo flows, and the custom record type IDs used in UC10.
p0Blockers.body: NetSuite Connector v11.11 requires TBA with 5 credentials. Integration role needs minimum permissions: Transactions (Create/Edit), Inventory (View/Edit), Customers (Create/Edit), Items (View), Custom Records (Create/Edit). Sikich already has admin access from Celigo — they can create the MuleSoft role in the same session. Bundle all three credential/data requests into one Sikich call.
bundledWith: Shopify Custom App — API Credentials (same client setup session)
Celigo Flow Inventory Spreadsheet (Sikich can provide)

p0Blockers.title: Shopify Custom App — API Credentials
p0Blockers.clientAction: In Shopify Admin → Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop Apps: create a new app named 'DataSkate MuleSoft Integration'. Enable scopes: read/write orders, read/write inventory, read/write products, read/write customers, read/write fulfillments. Generate the access token and send to DataSkate.
p0Blockers.body: Shopify Private Apps are fully deprecated. Custom Apps are the only option for permanent access tokens. Required scopes must be set at creation — missing scopes silently fail (403). Also: define metafield namespace + key structure before UC5 development begins.
bundledWith: NetSuite TBA Credentials (same client-side setup session)

p0Blockers.title: UC9 Architect Clarification — Invoice Generation Mechanism
p0Blockers.body: INTERNAL FLAG — Kailash to confirm with Sikich: NetSuite invoices are system-generated from Sales Orders via internal billing engine — cannot create directly via API. The Celigo 'NetSuite SO → Invoice' flow must be: (a) MuleSoft triggers SO status update → NetSuite SuiteScript workflow generates invoice; (b) read-only invoice export for reporting; or (c) something else. Affects UC9 scope, hour estimate, and whether it remains a MuleSoft flow. Resolve in the same Sikich call as TBA credentials.
bundledWith: NetSuite TBA Credentials (resolve in same Sikich call)

pricing.recommendedModelRationale: Homage currently relies on Sikich to manage their Celigo integration layer — they are not self-maintaining. IaaS replaces that Sikich/Celigo dependency with DataSkate ownership: same operational model, better platform. Their in-house engineers are AWS/Laravel infrastructure, not MuleSoft. Implementation Only is appropriate only if they plan to hire a dedicated MuleSoft developer post-go-live — flag this question in the proposal.
pricing.psych_note: Operational-pragmatist buyer: IaaS frames as a single operational cost line replacing the Sikich/Celigo cost — no upfront, $X/month, done. Do not lead with 2-year totals; lead with the 6-month payment as the comparable to their current integration overhead.

Each has a clear promotion gate. Present as: 'We have identified 5 additional flows adjacent to your stated scope. These are not priced in this proposal but are ready to scope once you confirm interest.'
